title: A county named for a president
text: McKinley County, New Mexico, is named for President William McKinley. Its county seat is Gallup. Gallup was established in 1881 as a railroad hub.

s1.title: McKinley County
s1.quote: McKinley County was created in 1901 and named for President William McKinley. ... Gallup was then founded in 1881 [as a stopping point for the Atlantic and Pacific Railroad].
